dataStore.name: freevibe_prefs
dataStore.keystoreDecision: Legacy provider key values are removed after successful encrypted-store migration.

encryptedStore.restoreDecision: If ciphertext exists without its device-bound key, or the key is invalidated, Aura clears unreadable ciphertext and shows a persistent re-entry notice. Temporary Keystore errors retain ciphertext for retry.
encryptedStore.fallback: Settings distinguishes temporary Keystore unavailability from permanent re-entry. Old DataStore values remain until migration succeeds.

credentials.atRestPolicy: User-entered values use AES-GCM with a non-exportable Android Keystore key.
credentials.backupPolicy: Encrypted SharedPreferences and legacy DataStore credential fields are excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.
credentials.restorePolicy: A missing or invalidated device-bound key clears unreadable ciphertext and prompts for re-entry.
credentials.deletionPolicy: Clear or saving blank removes the encrypted value and its re-entry marker; Android clear-app-data removes the store and key.
credentials.exportPolicy: Excluded from library, collection, theme-pack, diagnostics, and support exports.
credentials.userControl: Settings API Keys dialog saves the value to Android Keystore-backed encrypted storage; Clear or saving blank removes it.

credentials.atRestPolicy: Any upgraded user-entered value uses the encrypted store only until startup retirement removes it.
credentials.backupPolicy: Encrypted SharedPreferences and legacy DataStore values are excluded from cloud backup and device transfer.
credentials.restorePolicy: No value is restored. Startup removes encrypted and legacy copies because the provider is retired.
credentials.deletionPolicy: Startup retirement, Android clear-app-data, or uninstall removes the value.
credentials.exportPolicy: Excluded from every user export and diagnostic bundle.
credentials.userControl: No Settings field. Aura removes any retired Freesound value from encrypted storage and legacy DataStore on the next app start.
